Tag General

Duration constant

Your Quiet-state boons remain active while Unveiled — previously the two states were exclusive.

Your Quiet-state boons remain active while you are Unveiled. Every other rule of the two states is unchanged: Unveiled still ends when it normally would, still costs what it normally costs, and the spirit is still no longer entirely you while it lasts.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Quiet-state boons remain active while Unveiled" needs the Quiet/Unveiled state pair to have rule-element representation to condition on. Hollowbound's entire Toll / Fraying / Quiet-Unveiled / Parley system has zero rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus -- classes.hollowbound.json ships system.rules: [] and defines the whole subsystem only in flags.cinderfall prose (the terms array and progression table). Confirmed via grep -rli "SpecialResource" across feats/class/hollowbound/ and classes.hollowbound.json -> zero matches. Note: SpecialResource with renew:false IS a real, precedented mechanism for a manually-tracked, non-daily-refilling pool (confirmed live in this very corpus at feats/class/fleshmancer/fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json, max:10, renew:false) -- so this is not an engine limitation, but there is no equivalent "Toll Pool"-style classfeature card anywhere in feats/class/hollowbound/ to attach such a rule element to; a card would need to be authored first, which is out of scope for a gap-filling pass over the existing 75 cards.
